steps.name: Verify distribution configuration and shell entry points

scope: Includes seven new ObserveCollaborationInbox simulator cases and compilation of owned offline inbox previews.  Chat navigation, natural-width bubbles, locale dates, compact composer and saved pagination end are compiled from this source. Presentation tests and PNG inspection are local desktop evidence; the simulator domain suite does not execute those UI tests.Includes new workspace-domain simulator execution (34 common cases,14 selection cases) and full Xcode compilation of typed app navigation. App bootstrap/navigation tests execute on desktop, not in this simulator workflow. Full hosted core and collaboration-domain simulator tests plus Xcode application, including five point-read and three durable-dismissal intent cases. Common application action coordinator is compiled; its actual Koin/SQLite behavior is exercised separately on desktop with a simulated OS display. Android action callbacks are proved separately on API35; this Apple build compiles the common callback coordinators but does not execute Android or SystemUI. Requires two AppleCommandPrevention Room cases, seven discard/seven observe/fourteen complete cases, and preceding protected-input domain/raw cases. Saved-reply UI, VM, actual Koin and encrypted feature repositories compile into Xcode; their tests execute separately on desktop/SQLite/real browser, not in this simulator task. The new common ApplicationNotificationHost and readiness gate compile in Xcode; host/DI integration tests run on desktop, not this simulator workflow. Product Android binding does not establish iOS native delivery. Chat push OFF. New background pusher scope has11 domain cases including3 background regressions. Application registration/permission/wake/cleanup behavior runs on desktop and compiles into full Xcode; no Apple native push behavior is claimed. Physical iPhone waived; no APNs/CallKit acceptance.
